findings.one_line: The outcome-free M_PSRR^x proof controls its kink term via q_{ni} and F(q,q'), but q requires h, residuals, and s_n and is not defined in that class; replace it by the d-only antisymmetric kernel (with coordinates l<=k) or rescope the theorem.

Uniformity is proved only through nL auxiliary all-pairs ticks but is transferred to nL opposite-label proposal times, whose inverse all-pairs clock is about 2nL; establish the shadow/coupling bound through a fixed horizon larger than 2L before this transfer.

The Gaussian-initialization/positive-acceptance argument invokes lem:complete-randomization-vector-clt, but that cited node is absent from depends_on; add it (or reproduce the CLT invocation from an allowed dependency).
Its load-bearing joint normal initialization is an invocation of lem:complete-randomization-vector-clt, which is not declared in depends_on.

The proof imports the uniform q-score bound as established by the initialization proof, but lem:initial-score-clt is not a dependency; derive the bound directly from the listed primitives or declare the dependency.

The claimed distinction from uniform rerandomization is deferred to prop:not-uniform-rerandomization-design-class, a downstream node absent from depends_on; prove the comparator's zero boundary mass here from def:truncatedGaussian or relocate the claim.

cited_checks.note: The supplied attestation specializes Li--Ding (2017), Theorem 5, to two equal arms with the same centered fixed vector outcome in both arms and the signed contrast; its covariance and maximal-term hypotheses yield exactly the stated balanced-allocation vector CLT.
